page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is a memory-optimized server powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor with an x86_64 architecture. It features 90 dedicated vCPUs derived from 45 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 720 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core, and includes 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across 8 local drives. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates top-tier multi-core performance, ranking in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, PassMark CPU scores, and software compilation with Clang. It also achieves top-tier results in cryptographic encryption and ray tracing. Memory read bandwidth is strong, reaching 6368.24 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 217.31 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, though large block write bandwidth remains in the average tier at 77.28 GB/sec.

Given its high memory-to-core ratio and integrated high-speed local NVMe storage, this server is highly cost-efficient for memory-intensive and storage-heavy enterprise workloads without the overhead of discrete GPUs. It is well-suited for large-scale database operations, Redis deployments, static web serving, and medium-scale language model prompt processing.
